name: magic-video
description: Render stills and clips from shared brand primitives, fonts and theme-derived colors; today it draws every image in media/.
author: Gabriel Taveira <gabrielstaveira@gmail.com> (https://github.com/GSTJ)

scripts.render:all: pnpm run render:theme && pnpm run render:theme-palette && pnpm run render:codemods && pnpm run render:codemods-gif && pnpm run render:oxfmt && pnpm run render:oxlint-config && pnpm run render:oxlint-plugin && pnpm run render:tsconfig && pnpm run render:docs && pnpm run render:observability && pnpm run render:readme && pnpm run render:social && pnpm run render:video && pnpm run render:video-gif && pnpm run render:magic-demo
scripts.render:codemods-gif: pnpm run render:codemods-demo && remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/intermediate.mp4 -filter_complex "scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,split[s0][s1];[s0]palettegen[p];[s1][p]paletteuse" -r 12 -t 15 ../../media/magic-codemods-demo.gif
scripts.render:magic-demo: remotion render MagicDemo out/intermediate.mp4 && remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/intermediate.mp4 -filter_complex "scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,split[s0][s1];[s0]palettegen[p];[s1][p]paletteuse" -r 12 -t 15 ../../media/magic-demo.gif
scripts.render:video-gif: pnpm run render:video-demo && remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/intermediate.mp4 -filter_complex "scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,split[s0][s1];[s0]palettegen[p];[s1][p]paletteuse" -r 12 -t 15 ../../media/magic-video-demo.gif
